g.text: Turns the planned Claude Code panel on. Nothing reads this yet.
The kill switch for every Hindsight hook. Off stops recall and capture in all repos.
Lets a claude -p agent sample each repo to seed memory. It reads untracked files too.
Memory is active only under these folders. One per line.
Whether the local coding-agent daemon answers. hindsight-memory status shows more.
Changes ~/.claude/settings.json only. The tracked agents/claude-settings.json is the seed.
claude-config save copies a change into the repo. A --model flag, ANTHROPIC_MODEL, or a
model set in project or managed settings outranks it.
